source: repeated_category_analysis.json all_cells; previously computed and independently verified profiles

window_definitions.index_convention: zero-based physical-site indices; all stop indices excluded

original_endpoint_definitions.edge_sites_per_end: use each stored pair's existing edge_sites_per_end = n//10; 40 at N=400 and 60 at N=600
original_endpoint_definitions.edge10pct: left10pct + right10pct using that existing endpoint width
original_endpoint_definitions.purpose: reproduce the frozen comparison exactly; never replace it with fixed40 quantities

size_contrast: N=600 minus N=400 at fixed seed, strength and pair_index
signed_asymmetry40: (right_outer40 - left_outer40) / (right_outer40 + left_outer40); descriptive fixed-window quantity, distinct from original absolute asymmetry
definition_correction: The first draft incorrectly used fixed40 as though it were the original n//10 endpoint window. The failing cross-check exposed this before acceptance. Both definitions are now separated; no original data, category or threshold is changed.
fixed_window_rationale: Resolve the known outer-edge sign conditions and test whether adjacent inner or central weight accompanies them; fixed site counts are descriptive, not optimized cutoffs.
